chapter.verse: Tua ahih ciangin bang i ci gen ding hiam? Hehpihna a khan’ theih nadingin mawhna hihin i om ding hiam? Tua bang hi zenzen lo ding hi!
Mawhna ah a si eite in tua mawhna sungah bangci-in i hing lai ding hiam?
Khazih Zeisu sungah a kibaptaiz eite khempeuh in ama sihna sungah kibaptaizna i ngah hi ci-in thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Tua ahih ciangin sihna ah baptaizna-in Zeisu tawh i kivui khawm hi. Khazih in Pa’ vangliatna tawh sihna pan hong thawhkik mah bangin eite in zong hin’na thak i zuih theih nading ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ama sihna lim la-in amah tawh eite pumkhat sakhat i suah takpi leh, Topa thawhkikna lim zong la-in pumkhat sakhat i suak hi.
Khialhna tawh kipawl pumpi a kisuksiat nading ahi zongin, eite in mawhna’ sila a, i om loh nading ahi zongin, eite pumpi lui in amah tawh singlamteh tungah sihna a thuak khawm zo hi cih i thei hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a sisa mi in mawhna panin a suakta hi.
Khazih in sihna pan thokik ahih ciangin, sihna tawh kipelh tawntung a,
sihna in a nung ciangin amah a uk loh nading i thei ahih ciangin, eite in Khazih tawh i sih khawm leh, amah tawh i nungta khawm ding hi, ci-in i um hi.
Khazih in sihna a thuakna pen khialhna lam pan khatvei bek a si hi. A nuntakna in Pasian ading a nungta hi.
Tua mah bangin mawhna lam pan a si mi na hi uh a, Khazih Zeisu hangin Pasian lam pan mihing na hi uh na ciamteh un.
Tua ahih leh, note in deihgawhna na zuih nadingun, khialhna in a si thei na pumpi sung uh ah na ki-uksak kei un.

Tua tham loin na pum tung nate in diklohna’ hiam a suah nadingun mawhna kiangah na pia kei un. Sihna pan a thokik mi bangin, Pasian kiangah na pumpi uh na pia un. Dikna’ hiam bangin Pasian kiangah na pumpi tung nate zong na pia un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, thukham nuai-ah om loin, hehpihna nuai-ah na om uh ahih ciangin na mawhna un note hong uk lo ding hi.
Tua bang ahih leh, bang i ci hih ding hiam? Thukham nuai-ah om loin, hehpihna nuai-ah i om ahih ciangin khialhna i hih ding hiam? Tua bang hi zenzen lo ding hi.
Mi khat kiangah sila dingin note na tum uh leh, tua mi in sihna tawh kituak mawhna thu ahi zongin, dikna tawh kituak thu ngaihna ahi zongin, note’ to ahih thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Note in mawhna sila na hih ngei uh hangin, tu-in na ngahsa uh thuhilhna, deihna lungtang tawh na ngai uh ahih ciangin Pasian’ hehpihna ka phat hi.
Mawhna’ khut sung pan na suahtak khit uh ciangin, dikna’ sila na suak uh hi.

Na lungsim uh nem lai ahih ciangin, leitung ngeina bangin thu kong hilh hi. Note in na pum tung uh nate, kihhuaina leh kheltatna’ sila-ah na om sak uh mah bangin, tu-in na pum tung uh nate a kisian’thosak nadingun dikna’ sila-ah na omsak un.
Mawhna’ sila-ah na om lai takun dikna tawh na kipelh uh hi.
Tua ahih leh, tu-in zumhuai na sak uh tua gamtatna na bawl lai takun, bang phattuamna na ngah uh hiam? Tua gamtatnate’ tawpna lampi in sihna ahi hi.
Tu-in mawhna’ khut sung pan na suakta uh a, Pasian’ sila suak khin na hih ciangun siangtho nadingin phattuamna na ngah uh a, a tawpna-ah nuntak tawntungna na ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, sihna in mawhna’ thaman ahi hi. Ahih hangin i Topa Khazih Zeisu hanga nuntak tawntungna in man kipia lo Pasian’ letsong ahi hi.
